title: Reader TTS can briefly show a 0m countdown label when the timer expires
symptom: At TTS timer expiry, the reader bottom-bar or notification state can briefly project an ongoing session with a remaining-time label such as "停止朗读 · 0m" or "0m" before the service finishes stopping playback.
root_cause: ReaderTtsService publishes updatedRemaining = 0 to ReaderTtsController and refreshes the notification before calling stopByTimer and stopping the playback service. ReaderTtsReaderUiStateResolver and ReaderTtsNotificationFactory formatted any non-null remainingTimerMillis through ReaderTtsTimeLabelFormatter, and the formatter coerced zero or negative values to "0m" instead of treating expired budgets as not displayable.
fix: Add ReaderTtsTimeLabelFormatter.formatPositiveRemainingMillisOrNull so shared UI code only displays positive timer budgets.
Route reader-side TTS toggle labels, immersive labels, and settings remaining-time labels through the positive-budget formatter.
Route notification remaining-time copy through the same positive-budget formatter.
Extract ReaderTtsNotificationTextResolver so notification content text follows the same remaining-time-or-stable-state rule without needing Android notification object inspection.

Add unit coverage for formatter rounding, expired-budget suppression, current-book reader UI states with zero or negative timer budgets, and notification content text for timed, untimed, paused, expired, and blank-summary states.
failed_attempts: Do not use formatRemainingMillis directly for live UI or notification labels; it is a low-level numeric formatter and intentionally still formats zero as "0m" for callers that want that literal representation.
Filtering only in ReaderTtsReaderUiStateResolver would leave the notification path able to show the same expired "0m" intermediate state.

Leaving notification text derivation inside ReaderTtsNotificationFactory makes the countdown/state rule hard to test directly, because assertions would need to inspect Android Notification objects instead of pure text output.
impact: Prevents timer-expiry edge states from showing contradictory countdown copy while playback is in the process of stopping, and keeps bottom-bar, settings, immersive, and notification timer visibility rules aligned.
